text:
elaine: Clearing out some stuff from my studio. Free: two matching velvet desk lamps (brass accents, working bulbs included) and a pair of GA tickets to a local comedy show (Sat 8pm). Pickup SF SOMA lobby or I can leave on curb Fri evening. Pics: https://img.example.com/velvetlamps.jpg and https://img.example.com/tickets.jpg. DM to claim.

noah: Lamps sound ideal. Any noticeable wobble?

elaine: Slight wobble on one base but tighten the screw and it's solid. Lamps are 16\" tall, shade diameter ~8\".

carlos: Ill take the tickets if no one's faster. Can do Sat morning pickup.

noah: If carlos wants the tickets, I'll grab the lamps. I can pick up Fri 6pm curbside.

elaine: Carlos first for tickets, Noah you're up for lamps. I'll leave both items in the lobby with a sticky that has the claimants' names. Please check in with reception and bring a bag for the lamps.

reception-bot: Friendly reminder: All lobby pickups require check-in at reception and a visitor badge. See pickup policy: https://company.example.com/office-pickups. If leaving items overnight, please label them clearly.

carlos: Thanks Elaine, I'll swing by Sat 9:30am and grab the tickets.

noah: I'll be there Fri 6:05pm. Elaine, want a hand with carrying the lamps down?

elaine: That would be awesome if you can help @noah. Appreciate it! :heart:

noah: No prob. Also, thanks for donating the lamps instead of tossing them.

elaine: Figured someone could use them. Enjoy the show @carlos!
